name: Kisasszonyfa (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Kisasszonyfa (a green shield with a yellow figure of the Virgin, with green and yellow mantling) above a yellow scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kisasszonyfa arms with mantling and scroll
